title: Week of Focus comms playbook (scratch)
content:
PURPOSE
- Quick scratchpad for the Week of Focus internal comms.
- Primary goal: align org around the initiative (short experiments to improve reliability/cost/latency) and surface immediate asks for engineers and PMs.
- This is a very rough working draft — notes to self + copy variants for Slack/email/All-Hands talking points.

OVERVIEW / TL;DR (30s)
- Week of Focus: Mar 22–26, internal week focused on small, measurable changes to reduce inference cost and SLO variance.
- Ask: each eng squad to land 1 small safety/latency/cost improvement, product squads to provide 1 eval/test case, Ops to run smoke tests.
- Outcome: a list of deployable items, metrics up/down baseline, and 2 quick wins we can scale.

AUDIENCE
- Primary: Eng (serving-runtime, platform, infra), Product, SRE, SolutionsEng.
- Secondary: Wider company (sales/support) for visibility; execs for outcome tracking.

KEY MESSAGES (single-line variants)
- "We’re running a Week of Focus to ship high-impact, low-effort inference improvements — everyone: 1 small thing, measurable effect."
- "A week of focused changes to make inference cheaper and more reliable — help us find fast wins."
- "Ship small, test fast: our Week of Focus will show how tiny changes add up in production economics."

ANNOUNCEMENT CHANNELS
- Slack: #company-all, #eng-serving-runtime, #product-notifications, plus team channels.
- Email: short summary to all@redwood (for execs + legal audit trail).
- All-Hands: 5-min mention + 1 slide showing goals/asks.
- Confluence: canonical playbook + tracker page.

SLACK ANNOUNCEMENT (short) — option A
Hey everyone — we’re running a Week of Focus (Mar 22–26) to ship small, high-leverage changes that reduce inference cost and improve latency/safety.
Ask: each eng/product squad aims for 1 measurable improvement. Sign up here: [tracker link]. We’ll share outcomes at next week’s retro and highlight wins in the All-Hands. Questions? drop them in #eng-serving-runtime.

SLACK ANNOUNCEMENT (short) — option B (casual)
Heads-up: Week of Focus is coming Mar 22. Think small fixes — code paths, cache rules, quant profiles, prompt tweaks. 1 goal per squad. Tracker + office hours link in the doc.

EMAIL SUBJECT SAMPLES
- "Week of Focus (Mar 22–26): 1 small change, measurable impact"
- "Help us find fast wins for inference — Week of Focus"

ALL-HANDS TALKING POINTS (3 min)
- Quick why: inference unit economics matter — this is about predictable cost and reliability for customers.
- What: one-week experiment where teams ship focused, testable changes (example: change a batch timeout, add a prefix cache for chat, switch quant profile for staging).
- Ask: each squad pick one item, estimate impact and landing plan, and log it on the tracker.
- Success: 2 wins with measurable delta (cost per 1k tokens, p95 latency, or error rate).
- Follow-up: results shared in retrospective + public summary in the Console dashboard.

SUGGESTED SQUAD-LEVEL ACTIONS (examples)
- Serving runtime: tweak batching policy, reduce max batch window from X->Y for selected routes.
- Platform: prewarm cache for top-10 frequent prefixes, validate cost delta.
- Dedicated: test fallback routing for overloaded nodes and document latency changes.
- Product: provide a focused eval set (10 prompts) to validate quality after quantization change.
- SRE: run smoke test harness and validate error classification tweaks.

Q&A (anticipated questions + draft answers)
Q: "Is this production or staging?"
A: Default: target staging first. If low-risk and owned by squad, we may ship to canary or limited prod. Document target environment on tracker.

Q: "How long will the changes run?"
A: We expect quick experiments (<1 week), but some changes may require longer measurement windows. Any prod changes must go through normal rollout and canary policies.

Q: "What counts as a success?"
A: Any measurable improvement in a defined metric (cost per 1k tokens, p95 latency by route, or error rate) with clear before/after measurement. Small wins add up.

Q: "Who approves prod changes?"
A: Squad leads + on-call SRE must sign off for production rollouts. Use existing rollout checklist.

TRACKER TEMPLATE (fields to put in tracker)
- Squad, owner, change summary, target environment, metric(s) to measure, baseline values, expected change, plan + rollout window, rollback criteria, post-mortem owner.

SAMPLE ITEMS (copyable into tracker)
- "serving-runtime / Liya — reduce batch-window for chat-route / staging / measure p95 -> expected -8%"
- "platform / Omar — enable prefix cache for FAQ route / canary / measure token cost -> expected -12%"

OFFICE HOURS / SUPPORT
- Daily office hours 10–11am in #office-hours and drop-in on Zoom (link on Confluence).
- Office hours owners: Maya (platform), Lena (serving runtime), Noah (coord).

COMM CHECKLIST (pre-publication)
- Draft Slack copy: final version by Mar 15.
- Send exec brief (1-pager) to leadership by Mar 16.
- Create tracker and invite squads by Mar 17.
- Schedule office hours + demo slot signups by Mar 18.

RISKS & MITIGATIONS
- Risk: squads push risky prod changes without canary.
  - Mitigation: enforce canary + SRE sign-off; clearly mark hazardous items on tracker.
- Risk: perceived one-off initiative with no follow-through.
  - Mitigation: require post-week summary and integrate top items into roadmap.

OPEN QUESTIONS (notes to self)
- Should we require a minimum measurable threshold to qualify as a 'win'? (e.g., >3% cost reduction) — undecided.
- How to credit cross-team work (solutions eng + eng) on tracker? add "contributors" field.
- Confirm exec interested metrics: finance wants $ saved estimate; SRE wants p95/p99. Need to reconcile.

POST-WEEK COMMUNICATIONS
- Retro doc + public summary with 3 highlighted wins and metrics.
- Short blog/internal post on learnings + what we’ll operationalize.

TODO (actionable items)
- [ ] Finalize Slack copy (Mar 15) — owner: Noah
- [ ] Exec 1-pager (Mar 16) — owner: Maya
- [ ] Create tracker with template (Mar 17) — owner: Lena
- [ ] Office hours calendar invites sent (Mar 18) — owner: Noah
- [ ] All-Hands slide (Mar 19) — owner: Lily (product comms)

NOTES / STREAM-OF-CONSCIOUSNESS (scratch)
- Keep language light — avoid sounding like a compliance drill.
- Highlight that this is about product/performance and not a headcount or cost-cutting message.
- Might offer a small internal "recognition" slack ribbon for squads that ship >2% improvement. Cheap morale boost.
- Consider short leaderboard for demo day (Friday) — public but opt-in.

END OF DRAFT — still iterative.

(If adding this to Confluence, clean up headings and remove TODOs; this doc stays as the raw scratchpad for comms wording and Qs.)
